solutionCode.python:
def reverse_list(head):
    prev = None
    current = head
    
    while current is not None:
        next_node = current.next
        current.next = prev
        prev = current
        current = next_node
    
    return prev

hints: Store current.next in a temporary variable BEFORE changing current.next
Point current.next to prev to reverse the link
Move prev and current forward: prev = current, current = temp
